classification: Closed original higher weighted Jacquet norm subobligations
checked: The exact mixed Jacquet identity factors each representation through one scalar, so its radial image has dimension at most one; zero images remain allowed.
The normalized signed Pieri identity has formal-degree ratio d_source/d_target, and the two moment estimates produce the inverse ratio in the upper bound.
Cauchy-Schwarz and the exact shifted Vandermonde sum give a column l1 bound with unchanged Cb>=Ch+5.
Iterated paths may collide; the proof uses the l1 coefficient bound before the final orthogonal squared norm. It does not infer an operator bound from column l2 bounds.
Every intermediate index retains q(q+1) reserve from the original q(p+q+1) condition; the original real budget and floor are retained.
Both character scales and both positive T parameters are retained. Zero starting norm, zero shifted images, r=0 and the empty word are handled.
The original OnePlaceEstimates norm interfaces are supplied; this package alone gives no equality at specified measure-zero points.
retained_inputs: Pointwise identification on the big cell (supplied separately)
The weighted orbital estimate on all relevant strata
Global rational-return comparison and the prescribed arithmetic period maps
